fitzgen opened PR #15329 from fitzgen:critical-edge-cold-pred to bytecodealliance:main:

They already inherited coldness from their successor, but this commit makes them also inherit it from their predecessor. If either is cold, then that implies that the critical-edge block is also cold.

This improves code quality by better falling though hot paths and better register allocation after https://github.com/bytecodealliance/regalloc2/pull/279 lands.
